info.description: Per-issuer signing keypairs, one row per key ever held (find-or-create the active one, add a new row and retire the old one on rotation). Never exposed over REST directly: no routes/controllers/services are defined for this content type itself -- reachable only from server-side code via strapi.db.query/entityService. Public keys are served through api::profile.profile's own routes instead (/profiles/:id/keys[/:keyId]), never the private key.
